rewrites.original: Execute this Agentic OS workflow using the selected provider. Vault root: ${root}.
rewrites.replacement: Execute this content-os workflow using the selected provider. Vault root: the content-os vault (see Terms above).
rewrites.reason: agentic-os interpolated its vault path into the prompt; content-os resolves the vault from --vault / CONTENT_OS_VAULT (defined in the adapter section).
agentic_vault was the agentic-os MCP server name; content-os bundles the same tool as a script.

rewrites.original: OUTPUT CONTRACT: The bridge owns the final report at ${destinationFor(job)}.
rewrites.replacement: OUTPUT CONTRACT: This skill saves the final report itself with `scripts/reports.mjs save --skill morning-intel` (step "Save" above), under the vault at `inbox/research/morning-intel/YYYY-MM-DD-intel-<id>.md`.
rewrites.reason: agentic-os has a bridge that saves the returned report. content-os has no bridge: the skill saves the report itself with the bundled reports.mjs (same vault-relative path rules as agentic-os) and still returns the complete Markdown.

rewrites.original: Do not write that destination yourself or substitute
rewrites.replacement: Do not write that destination any other way, or substitute
rewrites.reason: In content-os the skill writes the destination, but only through reports.mjs save, which never overwrites an existing report.

rewrites.replacement: Use the configured report time zone (`CONTENT_OS_TZ`, else the computer's zone) for report dating.
rewrites.reason: agentic-os rewrote America/Chicago to the machine time zone at prompt time (zoneText in workflows.mjs) and has no bridge-side zone setting here; content-os makes the report time zone configurable with CONTENT_OS_TZ, defaulting to the machine zone like agentic-os.

rewrites.original: End with observed generation time in CT. The bridge saves the complete answer; do not replace it with a short summary or a file link.
rewrites.replacement: End with observed generation time in the report time zone. Save the complete answer as the output contract says and return it in full; do not replace it with a short summary or a file link.
rewrites.reason: agentic-os has a bridge that saves the returned report. content-os has no bridge: the skill saves the report itself with the bundled reports.mjs (same vault-relative path rules as agentic-os) and still returns the complete Markdown. "CT" is the owner's Central Time abbreviation, which agentic-os did not rewrite for other zones; in content-os the report time zone is configurable.
